hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -I -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('grep' if d.get('tool_name')=='Grep' else d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *build-graph.sh*) ;; *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *) [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "graphify-out/graph.json exists. HIT=$(python3 -I -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);s=(str(t.get('file_path') or '')+' '+str(t.get('pattern') or '')+' '+str(t.get('path') or '')).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.py','.sh','.md','.toml','.yml','.yaml','.sql');sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify-out/' not in s and any(e in s for e in exts) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "graphify-out/graph.json exists.
